newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares end higher as some blue chips soar.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares end higher as some blue chips soar.

text.p: 1330 GMT - A rally in a few major blue chips such as Nestle, Swiss Re and Roche helped Swiss shares end a shortened session higher.

But apart from those blue chips, the market was mostly mixed, one trader noted. Some shares profited from favourable results and technical factors, others were pressured by an easing U.S. dollar, he added.
* Nestle continued to draw strength from better-than-expected 1996 results, rising 44 francs to 1,685.
* The blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI) gained 38.7 points, or 0.84 percent, to end at 4,659.2.
